contact_lead: Choose how you'd like to reach Dr. Isaac.
about_lead: With over 15 years of experience supporting individuals through life's most challenging moments, I offer a warm, professional space where you can be heard, valued, and guided with dignity.
about_quote: "Every person deserves to be heard, valued, and guided with dignity."
about_bio_p1: Whether you're navigating anxiety, relationship strain, grief, or personal growth — you don't have to do it alone. Based in KwaZulu-Natal, I offer both in-person and secure online sessions across South Africa.
about_bio_p2: My approach is grounded in respect for your story, your culture, and your pace. Together, we build clarity, practical tools, and a path forward that actually fits your life.
credentials_note: Ongoing professional development • Member of ethical counseling bodies • Your privacy and wellbeing are my highest priority.
trust_1_desc: What you share stays private. Ethical, secure practice.
trust_2_desc: You will feel heard without shame or pressure.
trust_3_desc: Leave each session with clear next steps that work.
trust_4_desc: In-person in KZN, or secure video anywhere in SA.
trust_5_desc: Respect for your values, faith, and background.
trust_6_desc: WhatsApp reply same day. Urgent slots available.
how_step_1_desc: Call or WhatsApp 0027 73091 8737. Tell me briefly what you need.
how_step_2_desc: Free 15-minute discovery call. We discuss goals and fit.
how_step_3_desc: Book weekly or biweekly — online or in-person.
services_lead: Choose the path that fits your season. Every session is compassionate, practical, and built around your goals.
service_1_desc: Anxiety, stress, depression, and self-esteem. One-on-one support to help you regain clarity and calm — at your own pace.
service_2_desc: For couples and families seeking deeper connection, better communication, and real resolution — without blame.
service_3_desc: Loss, career change, relocation, identity shifts. Gentle guidance through seasons of change — with space to make meaning.
service_4_desc: Purpose, confidence, boundaries, and life design. Become the person you want to be — with practical tools that stick.
closing_lead: A free 15-minute discovery call is the simplest first step. No pressure, no commitment — just a conversation.

books_what_title: Written with the same care as every session.
books_what_lead: Practical, warm, and grounded in over 15 years of counseling experience — these resources are designed to support you long after the session ends.
